title: How Different Is Stereotypical Bias Across Languages?

bias_targets.methodology: Context association tests (intra-sentence fill-in-the-blank and inter-sentence next-sentence prediction) using the translated StereoSet dataset to compare language model probabilities for stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical candidates.
